verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Apify acting as an MCP server, exposing its Actors to external AI agents and LLMs. That is the opposite role from this story. Nothing shows Apify can connect to or consume third-party MCP servers as a client, so the server-side evidence does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
